Team —

Per our prep sync this morning: we need a tight edit sprint to get the Q3 packet investor‑ready by EOD Tuesday (11/24). I mapped slide ownership below and flagged the sections that still need data or narrative polish. Please treat the drive files as single source-of-truth; I attached a compiled deck (.pptx) for quick offline review.

Ownership (please confirm by EOD today):
- Marissa: Executive summary + GTM highlights (slides 1–4)
- Karthik: Product & roadmap + release timeline (slides 10–16)
- Neha: Metrics appendix, ARR/NRR reconciliation (slides 20–26)
- Jonas: Risk & hiring narrative + ask slide (slides 27–30)

Immediate asks:
1) Marissa: squeeze in the 6–month cohort ARR waterfall on slide 3 — use the workbook tab named "Cohort Waterfall".
2) Karthik: update the delivery timeline with the minor shift (internal sprint -> beta launch +2 weeks). Put a note in the speaker notes where the change is called out.
3) Neha: reconcile the Cost of Revenue row in the appendix; legal flagged a discrepancy in payroll allocations.
4) Jonas: consolidate the hiring ask to a single slide; include headcount, timing, and cost impact.

Attached: Q3_board_packet_v3.pptx (compiled), Q3_metrics_appendix.xlsx. Drive master: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ3Board

Timeline:
- EOD 11/22: confirm ownership and post first-pass notes in comments
- 11/23 morning: edit sprint (real-time edits in Drive)
- 11/23 17:00: leadership review (Jonas + Soojin)
- 11/24 11:00: final sign-off from execs
- 11/24 afternoon: PDF to board distribution

If you have any blocking questions, flag here and ping me on Slack (soojin) for urgent items.

Thanks — soojin
